question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

19, 21, ?, 134, 538, 2692
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **

 
• Each number is multiplied by a whole number series starting with (1) subsequently.
 
• After multiplying (2) is added to each number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/965c35be878f8db6e4708ac8d9b63bb670876254bba3711a9491de6c530569c9.png] 

Hence,** "44"** is the correct answer.
